blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Senator Robin Padilla cried tears of joy upon seeing former President Rodrigo Duterte make his first in-person appearance before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Wednesday. A year and a half passed since Duterte attended his proceedings in the Hague, which he previously only attended via online video conferencing. “I was shocked and unexpectedly shed tears of joy when I saw him. But I was also filled with sadness because I knew that Father Digong is a strong man,” Padilla said in a text message to the media. “He was capable of courage and compassion, but […]...
